body.statement: For a finite-dimensional convex optimization problem with affine equality constraints and an affine conic inequality in a closed convex cone, if the primal optimal value is finite and there is a feasible point whose conic slack lies in the relative interior of the cone and whose ordinary inequality coordinates are strict, then the Lagrange dual has the same optimal value and a dual optimizer is attained.

source.locator: Boyd and Vandenberghe, Convex Optimization, Section 5.3.2, Slater's constraint qualification and dual attainment

attestation.note: Checked against the official author-hosted book PDF; this leaf states only the finite-dimensional Slater consequence used for the displayed SDP.
